description: Department of Trade and Investment - Do Hereby Mate Order to Waive-off Balance Amount after Collecting Rs. 1 Per kg from the Applicable Special Commodity Levy of Kg 200 Per Kg on Importation of Dates
categorisation: This gazette content is an Order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which modifies the application of a specific levy on imported Dates. It constitutes a regulatory action that amends how existing legislation is applied, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does so only to establish the authority making the Order and does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, nor does it announce his appointment or a government restructuring.
